items.headline:
Markets are bracing for a rate hike.

So, how do US stocks usually behave following the first hike of a Fed tightening cycle?

The S&P 500 has declined by an average of -4.0% over the 6 weeks following the first Fed rate hike of a cycle across 7 such episodes since 1988.

items.headline:
U.S. 20-YEAR TREASURY YIELD HITS 5.42%

The Treasury’s $13 billion 20-year bond auction cleared at a high yield of 5.420%, highlighting elevated long-term borrowing costs.

Demand remained solid, with a 2.57 bid-to-cover ratio, while indirect bidders took roughly $6.8 billion.
